title: Neon Oracle Plasma Globe
description: A glowing orange plasma globe sits on an ornate black and gold base inscribed with 'SEVIN 9821'. Inside the glass sphere, vibrant neon tendrils in green, pink, blue and yellow branch outward from the central electrode toward surreal symbols, a blue peacock-headed female figure with elaborate feather-like hair on the right, and abstract geometric shapes. The dark background is filled with floating colorful geometric forms and squiggles.
prompt: surreal painting of an ornate plasma globe with glowing orange core and multicolored neon lightning tendrils reaching toward the glass. Inside the sphere floats a mystical blue female figure with an elaborate peacock feather headdress. Abstract symbols, geometric shapes, and squiggles fill the dark cosmic background.
